test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d0505d307612d6cf1dce5e97401a8ced54be79a5519712f21135f64c8fc7df.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• D B Z X → D - 2 = B; B - 2 = Z; Z - 2 = X
 
• **C A Y V → C - 2 = A; A - 2 = Y; Y - 3 = V**
 
• T R P N → T - 2 = R; R - 2 = P; P - 2 = N
 
• N L J H → N - 2 = L; L - 2 = J; J - 2 = H

Hence, '**C A Y V**' is the odd one out.
